text:
Avery (CEO): Quick executive flash for the week — keeping it tight. TL;DR: Private GA is green for customers, Dedicated capacity expansion next week, two policy updates (data retention + third-party access), and a hiring sprint for infra and support. More below.

Mira (VP Product): Huge props to the product + infra teams on the Private GA rollout. Early feedback from pilot customers = "stable + predictable". Please file any post-GA bugs in #eng-runtime rather than DMs.

Jon (VP Eng): Thanks — infra is ready for the Dedicated burst on Tue. Action items: 1) autoscale policy toggle tested in staging, 2) rollback window set to 30m, 3) ops playbook updated. I pushed the playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/playbooks/dedicated-burst

Talia (Head of Sales): Sales is prepped for the Dedicated upsell. Need simplified one-pager w/ pricing bands and SLOs by Mon EOD. @Mira can you own? That one-pager will sit in the GTM folder.

Mira (VP Product): Yep, will drop a draft by Monday. Will include sample SLAs, expected throughput per SKU, and callouts for quantization tradeoffs.

Emma (People Ops): Hiring update: we opened 6 senior requisitions (3 infra, 2 support eng, 1 reliability PM). Recruiting is accelerating — interview loops locked, expected offers next 2–4 weeks. Reminder: refer-a-hire incentives still active.

Avery (CEO): Metrics snapshot (week-over-week): ARR growth +3.8%, free-trial conversion +12% (up), p95 generation latency 142ms (good), average token cost down 7% after caching/quantization changes. NPS pilot for Dedicated customers: 61.

Avery (CEO): Policy changes — heads up: 1) Data retention default reduced from 60 -> 30 days for free-tier workloads; customers can opt for longer retention under Dedicated/Private contracts. 2) Third-party data access policy tightened: vendor access requires EDR + annual attestation. Docs + update cadence here: https://confluence.redwood/security/policies#data-retention. Please review and flag concerns by Thu.

Jon (VP Eng): Engineering note: the retention change requires a schema migration in the audit log pipeline — we tested it with a shadow run yesterday, no regressions. I'll have the PR up for review tonight.

deploy-bot: deploy 1809.7 to prod started by @Jon — health checks passed, canary at 20% traffic.

Talia (Head of Sales): One client asked about longer retention for compliance — Emma and I will work on contract language + SOW template.

Emma (People Ops): On the hiring lanes — folks, please prioritize panel availability in Greenhouse this week. We have two strong candidates for infra lead; momentum matters.

Avery (CEO): Two asks before Friday: 1) Mir a — one-pager for sales, 2) Eng — confirm retention migration schedule. I'll run an all-hands micro-update Friday 11:00am PT focused on policy and hiring cadence. Short Q&A after.

Mira (VP Product): Got it.

Jon (VP Eng): Scheduling confirmed for the migration: Wed night low-traffic window.

Avery (CEO): Thanks all. Small note — celebrating the team dinner next Thurs for the Private GA launch. RSVP in #lunch-plans. :tada:

Talia (Head of Sales): I'll bring dessert. :cookie:
